notes: Rows are keyed by the designation 'd1xd2' because several rings share the same d1 with different d2 (e.g. 10x13.5 / 10x14 / 10x16, only 10x13.5 kept). The kept rows are the sizes that fit DIN 908/DIN 910 plugs (M10x1 -> 10x13.5, M12x1.5 -> 12x16, M14x1.5/G1/4 -> 14x18, M16x1.5 -> 16x20, G3/8 -> 17x21, M18x1.5 -> 18x22, M20x1.5 -> 20x24, M22x1.5 -> 22x27, M24x1.5 -> 24x29, M26x1.5 -> 26x31, M27x2/G3/4 -> 27x32, M30x1.5 -> 30x36, M33x2/G1 -> 33x39, M42 / G1 1/4 -> 42x49) - this pairing is from Ganter's own table plus the DIN 910/908 collar d2 values (verified in plug910/plug908). G1/2 (21x26) and M48/G1 1/2 (48x55) rows dropped for lack of a 3rd source. Ganter's rows 4*, 5*, 6.5* are footnoted as special sizes. The thickness s of Al/Cu/St/Vf is identical; fibre/PTFE variants differ (not published).

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched Fuller, fasenco, Ganter, boltsfastener, theo live. 16 rows x 5 cols (80 cells). d1_min, d2_max, s compared across Fuller/fasenco/Ganter for every row: all 48 cells equal in the 3 sources except 24x29 s (Fuller 2, Ganter 2, fasenco 1.5). Nominal d1,d2 (designation) read from Fuller 'Phi4 x8' headers, fasenco 'size 4x8', Ganter 'd1/d2 Nennmass'. boltsfastener and theo are keyed by thread size (M24 etc.) with several rings per thread; they cannot confirm 15 of 16 rows cleanly (e.g. 12x16 appears with s=1 and s=1.5) so they were not counted; theo 'M24 29 2' supports 24x29 s=2. Checks: d1_min=d1+0.2 (d1<=22) or +0.3 (d1>=24), d2_max=d2-0.1, s 1/1.5/2 steps, strictly increasing.
problems: d1_min, d2_max and 15 of 16 s cells have exactly 3 clusters (Fuller, fasenco, Ganter); they pass only if all three are independent. Evidence: fasenco lists sizes Fuller lacks (5x9, 6x10, 10x14, 12x18, 13x18, 16x22, 20x26, 21x28, 22x29) and Fuller lists many fasenco lacks; fasenco typos (21x26 d1 21.25, 23x28/24x29 s=1.5) are not in Fuller/Ganter.

24x29 s=2 is the weakest cell: Fuller + Ganter explicit, theo thread-keyed row 'M24 29 2' (mapping thread->ring inferred), fasenco dissents with 1.5 (same file also has 23x28 s=1.5, a block typo). Numerically 3 clusters agree; flagged for the lead.

d1_min/d2_max are actual-size limits (Ganter 'Istmass +0,3 / -0,2', Fuller d min / dc max), not nominal; label them as such. boltsfastener page title uses 'Cooper' (same template as fasenco) - ignored.
Ganter marks 4x8 (and 5*,6.5*) 'nur in CU und AL lieferbar' - availability only, dimensions identical.
Producer note claims Fuller lists 5x9/6x10/10x14/16x22; it does not (irrelevant for kept rows).
